about: The Supertonic vector estimator compiled for Platform 3.0. The compile in florianvoss/supertonic-3-sima (Model Compiler 2.1.3) does not load on Core 0.6; this one, from the SiMa model zoo, does. setup.sh downloads it with sima-cli and checks it; the engine checks it again before loading. Moving to the Model Registry is planned.
